title: LG32-ASYM125-TAGBANK: sample index1/3, time and quantum index2/3, classical linear

claims.statement: For the single LG32-ASYM125-TAGBANK physical algorithm and fixed configuration supplied completely in proof.md and virtual.md (finite exhaustive branch for n<2^60; otherwise exact z=ceil(cuberoot(n)), w=floor(3249z²/10000), y=ceil(499z/5000), Hb=ceil(23378749z²/4990000),32 binary levels followed by y levels of32-input merges, and the supplied full counted implementation with the explicit full-b-bit root-record filter in MARK and classical append), for every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ with n=ceil(log2 N), unconditional whole-secret success is at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERY branch time is O(2^((2343/500)*n^(2/3))), ordinary classical space O(n), full allocated quantum space O(2^((13/40)*n^(2/3))) and total acquisitions O(2^((1/2)*n^(1/3))). All failures, rejected/discarded inputs, partial attempts, retries, caps, aborts, initialization, exact finite overflow repair, source moves and output-first cleanup are included with absolute constants. The time upper envelope has exact index2/3.
